dataList.content: <color=#7d7d7d>Though thou canst sate thyself, thou shalt not. Though thou canst indulge, thou shalt refrain.</color>

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: You've got the look of someone fresh out of the crib. A new customer.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Are... are you talking to me?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Who else? A fool with the gall to pair a Le Noir shirt with that revolting Rouge coat—you.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Have you come to buy shoes?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Y-yes. I was told this was the place to go for a good pair...
It's already been two whole seasons since I first set foot in Grand Magasin Sisyphe.
I still haven't thrown in my lot with either the Rouges or the Noirs. All this time, I've been searching for some way to get word to the world outside...
... but no one here has the faintest idea how. Everything in this department store travels by word of mouth: conversations, rumors... and nothing beyond that.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: S.W.R.Y.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: ... Sorry? I mean, pardon?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: It means "Surprised word reached you."
Is that how this department store works? The higher you climb, the further you leave common sense behind?
No matter how I look at it, I just can't figure out why she felt the need to chop "surprised word reached you" down to "S.W.R.Y."

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: I'm trying to get somewhere. I've been going back and forth all over the department store, looking for that place... And all that walking's worn my shoes right down.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Do you have a pair that'll hold up? Something sturdy enough to take a bit of wear and tear...?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: The soles of my feet are really starting to feel it...

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Hardly surprising. You insist on trampling the ground with both legs, every chance you get.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Still... as a Two-legs, I suppose you're walking on few enough legs to merit service.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: These ones look nice... How much would a pair set me back?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Oh...? So there is a little taste beneath that appalling ensemble.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: 320 eyeballs. They're woven from fabric that had been left to bask under bright sunshine for a good, long while... until it dried out to the very last thread.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Four-legs. Go to the storage and fetch the insoles for this pair.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: "Four-legs"...?
The table the proprietress of the Footwear Hall was resting her leg on... or what I'd assumed was a table... began to move, walking away on all four legs.
Sure, this department store is full of people who look as though they've gone overboard with bodily modifications, or have prostheses grafted onto every inch of their bodies...
But walking around on four legs? That's a first.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Tch. Crawling on all four legs, and the lowly plebeian still can't pick up the pace.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Walking on four legs... makes you a lowly plebeian?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Shoes may be made for walking upon the ground, but there is no dignity in trampling about without a care. It's the height of vulgarity.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: And naturally, the shoes you wear are worth all the less for it.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Ah, right... But what does that have to do with—
<color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt not defy the rules. Every moment of thy suffering is etched into and remembered by Sisyphe itself.</color>

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: ... Don't question what is self-evident, stranger, or the order upheld by our rules.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Um... One-leg, ma'am.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: What is it?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: ... I'm afraid we're out of the hide insoles for those shoes.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: And you didn't think to review our stock before we opened for business...?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Gah...!
The proprietress kicked Four-legs all the way across the hall, then stood up with a disgusted click of her tongue.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Follow me, stranger.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: W-where are we going?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: To the Rouge Footwear Hall. We're paying those red wretches a visit.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: For insoles, at least... their hides are second to none.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Revolting things... Flaying the Golden Resin off the walls as you please, all to plaster it over your lowly bodies...

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Consider yourselves privileged. I'm giving you the chance to become a One-leg's insole.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: W-wait a minute... I thought we were here to make insoles for my shoes...?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: ... I'll consider it if there's material to spare.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: What...?!
No sooner had the words left her mouth than the proprietress launched herself at the Rouges. Her leg was already sweeping through the air before I could even blink.

Every so often, a shockwave erupted amid her kicks and tore through the store. In the space of a few moments, the Rouges' store was reduced to a shambles, as though a storm had ripped straight through it.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Whoa... that thing you just did, with those shockwaves... Was that N Corp.'s Singularity at work? Or some kind of tech that uses it?

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: "Singularity"...? What's that supposed to mean?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Uh... well, I was going by the fact that you work here at Grand Magasin Sisyphe... You're one of the staff, aren't you?

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: So I figured your equipment would use N Corp.'s Singularity... or at least have some patented tech worked into it. That's why I asked...

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: S.O.D.A.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: "Such outlandish drivel, astonishing," N.C.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: But enough of that. Stop being a nuisance and move out of the way.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: Need to land a proper kick to take them out—the reds have hides as tough as old boots.
At first glance, you might've thought there was only one person standing guard over the Rouge store...
But appearances only tell a part of the story in this place.

The Alterationist had told me about... "The Shadowed", if I'm not mistaken. A space shared by customers of sufficient rank and the right aptitude... or by those with similar ways of thinking, or similar tastes.
And that means...

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: ... I suppose that takes care of the insole shortage.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: So it would seem. But... there's a snag, stranger.

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: They've layered on more Golden Resin than I expected. The content... is at least twice what I'd allowed for.

dataList.title: Customer
dataList.content: Hang on... Don't tell me—

dataList.title: Le Noir Footwear Hall
dataList.content: 500... No, make that 600.
... Guess I'll head back downstairs and scrounge up more eyeballs.
